data.name: Steffen
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old High German word stetan, meaning to stand or establish. The name Steffen is a compound of the Old High German words stet and and, meaning 'crown' and 'garland' or 'wreath' respectively. In medieval Europe, it was a common name for noblemen, as the name symbolized their position and authority.
